name: Perplexicube
description:
About This Game

Work together with your past and future selves in a challenging isometric grid-based puzzler where time must be looped backward for you to move forward.

CONTROL TIME

Create loops in time with your ghost cubes! Your ghosts will repeat your previous actions, so you'll have to think ahead to set your future selves up for success. You're in control of time, which means you can take things at your own pace provided your past selves give you the time!

ALTER YOURSELF

Find different transmutations that give your cubes new abilities! These transmutations will effect how you and your ghosts must interact with each other which further expands puzzle complexity.

FEELING STUCK?

Every level contains a set of hints that will help nudge you in the right direction without giving you the full answer if you get stuck. If you really need it, you can also ask for the full answer.

COLORBLIND MODES

Many levels rely on being able to distinguish different colors of buttons and cubes. There are three colorblind modes available to help with this: protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia.

Key Features

  • Create ghosts that repeat your previous actions by going back in time. Work together with your ghosts to complete each level.

  • There are 3 different transmutations that alter your cube's abilities. These changes will effect how you and your ghosts must interact with each other.

  • Hints are available for every level if you get stuck. Special hint cubes will help nudge you in the right direction without fully giving you the answer (unless you ask for it).

  • 3 Colorblind modes are available: protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia.
short_desc: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.
